title: Mallikarjun Kharge condemns ‘shuddhikaran’ ritual after his Uttarakhand visit; J.P. Nadda expresses regret in Rajya Sabha
description: Uttarakhand Congress president Ganesh Godiyal alleged that the Shri Ram Sena, which conducted the ritual, had links to the BJP and the purification was done because Mr. Kharge is a Dalit
